The PKGBUILD downloads from the official vendor domain with pinned SHA256 checksums and extracts the contents without executing any untrusted code. The only disagreement was caused by a transient API error in one model when reviewing a benign .desktop file, which another model successfully reviewed and cleared.
data.disagreement_analysis: The 'inconclusive' verdict from qwen3-235b was triggered by an HTTP 400 API error when attempting to audit tableplus.desktop, not by any security concern. deepseek-v4-flash successfully audited the same file and correctly identified it as a standard, safe desktop entry.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to audit tableplus.desktop due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: The audit orchestrator should implement retry logic for transient API errors on individual files, especially for non-executable metadata files like .desktop, to prevent them from failing the entire package audit.
Models should be instructed to gracefully handle or report partial failures without necessarily escalating the entire package verdict to inconclusive if the failed file is low-risk.
